headline: Is Analog Devices (ADI) Trading At A Premium After Its 141% Run?
summary: Analog Devices has delivered a strong 141.5% total return over the past 5 years, yet its valuation checks and current pricing leave investors questioning whether the stock now leans expensive rather than clearly cheap.
